title: A Clearer Clinic Visit · 独立口语迁移
instructions: 先完成示范段的跟读诊断，再用不同人物、信息或立场录制自己的完整回答。示范与自由回答分别取证，服务未提供完整听音评阅时保持待评。
reference: A small clinic in the city has a new plan. The clinic wants to help patients understand their health habits. Last month, the nurses saw a problem. Many patients did not remember their doctor's advice. The clinic was busy, so the nurses had little time to explain. The patients were tired, and they forgot the information quickly. Now the clinic uses a simple information sheet. The sheet has three parts: A, B, and C. Part A is about sleep. It says, "Go to bed at the same time every night. Sleep is important because your body needs rest." Part B is about food. It says, "Eat vegetables every day. Drink water, not sweet drinks." Part C is about exercise. It says, "Walk for 30 minutes a day. Walking is the easiest exercise." The nurses also ask patients questions. For example, "Do you sleep eight hours? Do you eat breakfast?"
prompt:
Part 1
Do you sleep eight hours every night?
What do you eat for breakfast?
Do you like walking?
Is your clinic near your home?

Part 2
Describe a healthy habit you have. You should say:

Part 3
Why is sleep important?
Should children exercise every day?
Is walking better than running?
What is the healthiest food in your city?
